status: THE GAUGED LAYER SUPPLIES A PER-CLASS BOND NUMBER, BUT IT IS NOT THE ONE THAT CLOSES THE MEETING (O4). At theta* the Wilson direction leaves a 13-dimensional centralizer, and the flux of BROKEN generators through each fragment class, K_s = 45 - C_2^{unbroken}(s) = [32.0, 36.0, 40.0, 28.0, 32.0, 40.0], is an integer number of the root with no free parameter (the FULL adjoint sum is class-blind to 1e-13, which is the V93/V95 degeneracy as an identity).
